
## External funding

```{r}
library(tibble)
tribble(
  ~ Grant, ~ Amount, ~ Year,
  "Alberta Conservation Association Research Grants", "$23,900 (Mount Royal University)", "2026 (one year)",
 "Manitoba Habitat Heritage Corporation Fish & Wildlife Enhancement Fund", "$81,400 (Memorial University of Newfoundland)", "2018 (over two years)",
  "Nature Conservancy of Canada Science Support Program", "$15,000 (Memorial University of Newfoundland)", "2018 (over two years)" 
) %>%
  detailed_entries(Grant, Year, Amount)
```
